self_corrections.what: VT doubles retirement withdrawal rate from 4% to 8%
self_corrections.correction: Bootstrap 5 block sizes: 8% survival only 25-28%. VT max safe = 4% = same as B&H.
Controlled test: rho(StdDeltaW, MDD)=-0.007 (p=0.87). Zero effect. True mechanism: crisis reactivity.
Contains uncapturable overnight gap. Implementable o2o Sharpe ~0.87. Gap R2=0.35 absorbs signal.

self_corrections.what: GJR > GARCH reversal under Parkinson proxy (42 days)
self_corrections.correction: Small-sample artifact. Full sample N=563: GJR wins under ALL proxies.
Regime-dependent: crisis w=504, calm w=5000. Adaptive window cannot beat fixed.
